Exchange Student (I)
A program that allows students to study a language or major and earn credits at an overseas sister school that has a student exchange agreement with our school.
Dispatch Conditions
Tuition and fees are paid to our school during the period of study abroad, and tuition and fees at the other school are waived.
Credits earned at the counterpart school will be recognized as credits at our school (credits for majors can be recognized)
Support for arranging housing at the other school
(Depending on the situation of the sister school, dormitories or outside dormitories may be arranged.)
Application Requirements
Undergraduate students who have completed or are in the process of completing or enrolling in at least two semesters at the University and who are able to study at the University for their final semester.
Language Proficiency
English speaking countries : TOEIC 750 or above (If TOEIC is not accepted by the partner institution, TOEFL iBT 80 or above or IELTS 6.5 or above)
Japanese speaking countries : JLPT level 2 (N2) or above, JPT 560 or above (conditions differ depending on universities, if necessary, please apply for consultation separately)
Chinese-speaking countries : Holders of the new HSK Level 4 or above or those with equivalent ability.
Recruitment and Dispatch Period
Recruitment: Once each semester (March, September), recruitment and selection one semester prior to the semester of dispatch
Dispatch: Next semester after recruitment and selection (varies by language area)

Various scholarships for exchange students
Sister University Scholarship : Provides a certain amount of scholarship through an agreement with our school.
Japan Student Services Organization (JASSO) Scholarship: The number of scholarship recipients is determined based on the annual plan of each university in Japan.
Exchange students sent to Japan can apply for this scholarship, and final selection is made by sister universities in Japan (amount awarded: 80,000 yen per month)v
Mirai Mirai Scholarship for Exchange Students : The Mirai Mirai Park Hyun-joo Foundation will screen and select exchange students to be sent overseas to receive a scholarship that covers tuition, airfare, and living expenses, Scholarship for exchange students: Scholarship that covers tuition, airfare, and living expenses (maximum annual stipend: 11.8 million won)
